CaseAnalysis.description:
The Judge's final analysis. Gives a leaning per issue, never a verdict.

Checks that need the whole Case Record (citations only to verified/weak evidence,
every S0 issue covered, unverified treatment listed in ``limitations``) are enforced
by the Case Record, not here.

disclaimer.default: This is a research output generated by an automated system. It is not legal advice and not a judgment. Verify every authority against the official source before relying on it.
